evidence: Redesigns CScriptWitness storage and limits pre-allocation during block and transaction deserialization in src/primitives/transaction.h and src/script/script.h.
rationale: Eliminates a critical validation-time memory and CPU exhaustion vulnerability from crafted blocks. Benchmarks in the description show worst-case valid block deserialization time drops from 279 ms to 19 ms, persisted memory drops from 106.8 MiB to 3.8 MiB, and peak memory falls from 182 MiB to 7.8 MiB.
